trigger: Selected constrained pilot had a best epoch of 289 and stopped at the 300-epoch ceiling in one of eight units.
selection_rule: Choose extended only if validation Q rRMSE improves at least 0.5% and at least 6 of 8 units are no worse, or if baseline hit the ceiling and pooled extended Q is lower while all checkpoints remain P-feasible.
test_policy: No test evaluation or saved test prediction.
